reason: The user confirmed items to remove and refund method, but the candidate call passes new_item_ids as an empty list. modify_pending_order_items is defined for exchanging items to different options of the same product (item_ids must map one-to-one with new_item_ids of same product type); it is not a removal/deletion mechanism, and the policy's Modify pending order section only allows changing shipping address, payment method, or product item options for a pending order, with each item modified to an available new item of the same product. There is no policy-supported action or tool for simply removing items from a pending order to shrink it while keeping the rest, and the empty new_item_ids array does not satisfy the tool's required one-to-one mapping. This is a material ambiguity: the requested outcome (delete 3 items, keep 2) is not clearly authorized by the modify_items procedure as described, and no cancel-and-reorder or partial-cancellation mechanism is provided in the policy. Executing the call as-is could misuse the tool or produce an unintended/invalid state.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option. There cannot be any change of product types
This action can only be called once, and will change the order status to 'pending (items modifed)'
new_item_ids: ... Each new item id should match the item id in the same position and be of the same product.
